observation: Full-canvas portrait pipeline visibly restores upright portrait framing and much more scene/person content than historical baseline, which was cropped/stretched. Person identity and background are more recognizable in samples. Motion quality remains inconsistent: f8/f20 strongly blurred, f60 body/face collapses, f80 hair/face deforms.
conclusion: Input geometry defect is real and this remediation visibly improves framing, but case12 Stage3 is not yet quality-pass. Stage2 was also rerun, so the comparison is an end-to-end canvas/geometry change, not isolated Stage3 effect.
limitations: Six sampled frames, not full continuous playback; no quantitative human fidelity assessment.
